description: This Java source file defines the UtilityReceiver class, a WakefulBroadcastReceiver used to keep the device awake while processing geofence trigger events in the XYZTouristAttractions app.

classes.name: UtilityReceiver
classes.description: A broadcast receiver that ensures the device remains awake during geofence event processing.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the received broadcast, sets up the intent for UtilityService, and calls startWakefulService to process the geofence event.
